newsitem.title: USA: IPI Inc says seeking acqusisitions.
newsitem.headline: IPI Inc says seeking acqusisitions.

text.p: IPI Inc said Tuesday it was seeking growth through acquisitions and other opportunities.

"With a strong balance sheet and liquid position, we are also seeking growth opportunities through acquisitions and/or similar strategies that offer attractive returns," chief executive officer Bob Sutter said in a news release. "This includes looking at opportunities outside the printing industry."

The parent company of Insty-Prints Inc, the business printing company, said revenue from royalties fees for the first quarter ended February 28 increased to $973,000, up 7.2 percent over first quarter 1996, which it attributed to increased sales by existing Insty-Prints franchise owners.
Earlier Tuesday, the company said net income for the first quarter was $314,000, or $0.07 a share, up from $282,000, or $0.06 a share, a year ago.
